scope: structural accessibility baseline; not a claim of full WCAG conformance or assistive-technology certification

evidence.evidence: scripts/validate_static_site.py requires a skip-link on every canonical page and verifies that its fragment target exists.
The permanent validator requires a main landmark on every canonical sitemap page.
growth-os.css exposes the skip link on focus, defines form focus outlines, focus-visible treatment for interactive cards, and keyboard-operable button/navigation primitives.
Every canonical page is required to include the shared menu-toggle and canonical navigation; shared CSS supplies mobile breakpoints at 980px and 680px.
growth-os.css implements prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and disables smooth scrolling/transitions under that preference.
Public Shell Auditor execution 73575: 34 audited canonical pages, 0 nonconforming pages, 0 violations.

scope_limitations.limitation: A full axe-core/Pa11y browser scan and manual screen-reader/assistive-technology walkthrough were not completed in Stage 14.
scope_limitations.reason: The connected remote browser providers had authentication failures and the managed local Chromium environment blocks navigable URLs by policy.
scope_limitations.disposition: Not represented as full WCAG certification. Structural accessibility controls are independently enforced in source across all 34 canonical pages. A future assistive-technology audit remains recommended as continuous improvement, but there is no observed critical/high accessibility defect in the certified structural surface.
